## Subsidy and approvals
For eligible individual households, PM Surya Ghar assistance can be up to ₹78,000 under the current central subsidy structure. The applicant must meet scheme requirements, use compliant equipment, complete commissioning and receive approval. The amount is not guaranteed. Check the current rules on the official portal: https://www.pmsuryaghar.gov.in/.

Housing-society common-facility support has separate eligibility and capacity limits. These depend on the number of dwellings, the proposed common-meter capacity and approval. Confirm current terms with the scheme administrator and MSEDCL before making a financial decision.

E Green Solution can help prepare project and net-metering paperwork. MSEDCL and scheme administrators control technical feasibility, inspections, approvals, meter installation and subsidy payment.

## Estimates, savings and warranty terms
The online calculator is an indicative planning aid, not a quote. Its assumptions do not replace a site survey or utility assessment. System cost, generation, bill savings and payback vary by roof conditions, shading, equipment, usage, tariff and settlement rules. PM Surya Ghar support, society incentives and business tax treatment should not be treated as guaranteed deductions. Manufacturer and workmanship warranty terms vary by equipment and written project scope.

## Published case-study evidence
The Konark A Plus project page includes rooftop photographs and a walkthrough. The MSEDCL record described on the page documents 45 kW for one connection; this is not a claim for total society capacity or site-wide savings: https://www.egreensolution.in/projects/konark-a-plus-100kw-housing-society-solar-pune.
